evidence.why: Ingest manifest shows 0 rows read and loaded for 2026-10-21

evidence.quote: Order volume for 2026-10-21 is 100% below the 7-day average (threshold 25%)
evidence.why: Alert raised because order volume dropped to zero

args.root_cause: The upstream vendor API delivered an empty file (0 rows read) for run_date 2026-10-21, causing the order sync pipeline to ingest zero orders and trigger the volume drop alert.
args.suggested_fix: Check with the vendor why no orders were returned for 2026-10-21, and backfill the data once the vendor provides the correct file.
